vampires form my uncontrolled region to my ready region.

so i can move as many younger vampires as i got in my uncontrolled

You have to choose the vampire when you play the card. Nothing in card text
gives you oppurtunity to change vampire later.

> now my interpretation is the next: i play gather and move a vampire
> from my uncontrolled region to my ready region, the card remains in
> possetion of the vampire who played it, so that would mean that in my
> next turn i can tap gather again and select another younger vampire in
> my uncontrolled region.

Nope. However, you can use the same Gather to move the same vampire to the
ready region later, if it has for instance been banished.

> so i can move as many younger vampires as i got in my uncontrolled
> region to my ready region while the vampire who owns gather remains
> ready and gather reamins in play.
>
> is my interpretation right, or i minundesrtanded the card?

The latter.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
ThE_OnLy_VipeR wrote:

> My question about gather is if i can tap gather to move multiple
> vampires form my uncontrolled region to my ready region.

Only one.

>
> the card says: "put this card in play tapped and select a younger
> gangrel in your uncotrolled region, during your influence pahse you
> can tap this card to move that vampire to your ready region whatever
> counter he or she has".

When you put the card into play, you select the vampire. It doesn't allow
you to change the vampire you have selected. Also note that the card doesn't
leave play after the vampire in question is in play, so if you want to get
another vampire out with another Gather, you'll need to take an action to
remove the first one.

>
> now my interpretation is the next: i play gather and move a vampire
> from my uncontrolled region to my ready region, the card remains in
> possetion of the vampire who played it, so that would mean that in my
> next turn i can tap gather again and select another younger vampire in
> my uncontrolled region.

Incorrect.

>
> so i can move as many younger vampires as i got in my uncontrolled
> region to my ready region while the vampire who owns gather remains
> ready and gather reamins in play.

Nope. Gather chooses one vampire. When that vampire is in play, Gather is
mostly useless.

>
> is my interpretation right, or i minundesrtanded the card?

It looks like you have misunderstood the card. But that happens.
